families.title: Positive lower density of large prime gaps
families.headline: **026. Positive lower density of large prime gaps.** For every fixed C > 0, a positive proportion of consecutive prime gaps exceed $`C\log p_n`$, throughout every sufficiently large initial segment of the primes. For every C > 0, there is a sign-valued Boolean function f with $`\sum_i\widehat f(\{i\})\gt C\sqrt{\deg(f)}`$. families.title: Cycle–clique Ramsey numbers

families.title: Independent largest prime factors of consecutive integers
families.headline: **012. Independent largest prime factors of consecutive integers.** Resolves the Erdős–Pomerance joint Dickman conjecture: the logarithmic sizes of the largest prime factors of n and $`n+1`$ are asymptotically independent in ordinary natural density. In particular, the integers satisfying $`P^+(n)\lt P^+(n+1)`$ have density 1/2. ([Lean](lean/docs/012.md))

families.title: Uniformly bounded components of Gaussian-prime graphs

Uniformly bounded components of Gaussian-prime graphs.** Proves the Gaussian moat conjecture: no infinite walk through distinct Gaussian primes can have uniformly bounded steps. ([Lean](lean/docs/028.md))
